liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **pumpin for the man**: back after 173 archived shows (1958 days); rare: 10 archived performances [14]
- **powder blue**: back after 185 archived shows (1977 days) [14]
- **poopship**: rare: 7 archived performances [14]

## The recordings

- **ween2005-11-29.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 35 songs; 170 min; rated 4.64/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: Uploader expects this to be the best source to surface, calling the sound great; Sound is described as very good; Sound has a live feel yet is well balanced [1][5][6][10][11]

## Around the show

- The venue was packed full, and free cheese was handed out [8]
- The Lawrence crowd was great and appreciative, which reviewer says showed in the band's sets [13]
- The previous night in Lawrence is not circulating; reviewer says it ran almost four hours with about 44 songs [12]
- Reviewer says the band was at its best opening the new tour [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2005-11-29.flac16**: taped by Justin Hoogerwerf; transferred by Justin Hoogerwerf; source: Akg480b/ck61> Tascam DA-P1 @16/48(fob-din) [1]. Also: Two sources are known: this one and a minidisc recording; Uploader tried to find out what equipment made the recording but found nothing; Transfer ran from a Tascam DA-30mkII by digital coax into an Echo MiaMIDI, then Wavelab 5.0, downsampled to 44.1k, then FLAC [1][4]
